picks.title: บุกตรวจยึด SIM BOX ซ้อนใต้เพดานชั้น 4
picks.memo: 27 Oct 17:00 Region 2 police + Chonburi immigration raided a rented room in central Pattaya, seized SIM BOX devices hidden above 4th-floor ceiling linked to call-center gang; hunting the tenant.

picks.title: ตม.ระยองบุกไซต์ก่อสร้าง! รวบแรงงานจีน 4 เมียนมา 28 พบทำงานผิดกฎหมาย–อยู่เกินวีซ่า
picks.memo: Rayong immigration raided a construction site, arrested 32 foreign workers (4 Chinese, 28 Myanmar) for illegal work / overstay.

picks.title: EEC สร้างเมืองใหม่บางละมุง ต้นแบบ ‘กรีนซิตี้ ’ ทุ่มลงทุน 7 หมื่นล้าน
picks.memo: EEC plans new green city on 16,000 rai in Bang Lamung; private investment ~70bn baht in infrastructure, 50-year concession, 6 zones; to be proposed to cabinet.

picks.title: Laem Chabang Port opens new truck yards to ease congestion and waiting times
picks.memo: Laem Chabang Port opened 127 rai of extra support areas plus traffic measures to cut truck congestion and waiting times.

picks.title: Royal Thai Immigration Ordered to Track More Than 10,000 Foreigners Believed to Be Overstaying
picks.memo: Immigration commissioner Nopasin ordered nationwide pursuit of 10,000+ estimated overstayers (Bangkok, islands, border provinces).

picks.title: Thailand to deport Israeli woman after Koh Phangan outbursts
picks.memo: Immigration revoked visa of 33-year-old Israeli woman after repeated complaints on Koh Phangan (threats to park staff, ordering hotel guests out); to be deported.

picks.title: Swedish ‘cyber fraudster’ caught on Samui
picks.memo: Immigration police arrested Swedish 'David' wanted at home, hiding on Koh Samui; accused in AnyDesk remote-access fraud network (~20m baht per Thai reports).

picks.title: Thai police expose alleged citizenship network involving 24 children and eight hospitals
picks.memo: Phase 3 probe of fake Thai fathers registered for foreign mothers' children: 46 arrest warrants sought, 24 children, 8 hospitals checked.

picks.title: สภาพอากาศวันนี้ กรมอุตุฯ เปิดชื่อ 34 จังหวัด เตือน ฝนตกหนัก ลมแรง
picks.memo: TMD 28 Oct: heavy rain warning for 34 provinces, south continues heavy rain; Bangkok & vicinity thunderstorms 60% of area, gusty winds.

picks.title: ระทึก! ระเบียงตึกแถวถล่ม ย่านดินแดง จนท.เร่งช่วยคนติดบนอาคาร
picks.memo: 27 Oct 21:49 awning/balcony of ~5 shophouse units collapsed in Soi Pracha Songkhro 26, Din Daeng; about 9 people trapped, rescuers responded.

picks.title: กบน.หั่นราคา B20-E20 เหลือ 33.50 บาท/ลิตร ถูกกว่าดีเซล B7-โซฮอล์ 95 ถึง 10 บาท ช่วยค่าครองชีพ-หนุนเกษตรกร
picks.memo: From 28 Oct B20 and E20 retail 33.50 baht/litre after cabinet excise cut (3 months); 8-10 baht cheaper than B7/Gasohol 95.

picks.title: เริ่มแล้วโซลาร์รูฟล้านหลัง แห่ลงทะเบียนอื้อ ชั่วโมงแรกทะลุ 7 พันราย 'อนุทิน' กดปุ่มวันนี้-31 ม.ค. ครม.ลดภาษี 'B20-E20'
picks.memo: PM Anutin launched 1-million-household solar rooftop scheme; registration open to 31 Jan, over 7,000 registered in the first hour.

picks.title: นักท่องเที่ยวจีนร่วงหนัก หวั่นลากยาวถึงตรุษจีนปี’70 จี้รัฐเร่งสื่อสารรัฐต่อรัฐ หลังฑูตเตือนเที่ยวไทย
picks.memo: ATTA warns Chinese arrivals may fall up to 50%, possibly into Chinese New Year 2027, after Chinese embassy travel warning; urges govt-to-govt talks.

picks.title: Soldiers Seize 4M Meth Pills in Chiang Rai Border Clash
picks.memo: Pha Muang Task Force clashed with smugglers on Mae Sai border, seized about 4 million meth pills.

picks.title: ไม่รอดสายตา รวบหนุ่มเมียนมา คาด่านแม่สาย ลอบขนเงินสดข้ามแดน กว่า 3.5 ล้าน
picks.memo: 27 Oct Mae Sai customs caught a 21-year-old Myanmar man from Tachileik smuggling over 3.5m baht cash hidden in motorbike and bag.

picks.title: Flood victims in Phuket to get payouts
picks.memo: Deputy Interior Minister Worasit: Phuket flash-flood/landslide victims can claim disaster compensation even if flooding lasted under 7 days.

picks.title: Thai man Attacks Russian Driver With Metal Rod After Road Rage Incident in Thalang
picks.memo: 26 Oct ~18:30 road rage on Muang Mai–Pa Khlok Rd, Thalang: Thai man hit Russian motorist with metal rod; police identified suspect.

picks.title: TAT welcomes Kuwait Airways’ inaugural Kuwait–Phuket flight
picks.memo: Kuwait Airways launched twice-weekly Kuwait–Phuket flights; 8 weekly Thailand services total.

picks.title: Seaplane plan set to take off
picks.memo: Deputy Transport Minister Phattrapong accelerating seaplane services in the Andaman region for tourism.

picks.title: Taobao adds PromptPay at checkout in local push
picks.memo: Taobao adds PromptPay payment; Thailand is fastest-growing market by users among Taobao Tmall World's multilingual overseas markets.

picks.title: Thailand proposes five-year renewal of gun licenses under firearms bill
picks.memo: Firearms law amendment would require gun licences renewed every 5 years instead of lifetime; draft open for public comment on Parliament site.

picks.title: Thailand and Malaysia agree to improve security, travel and trade
picks.memo: Thailand-Malaysia agree to strengthen border security, ease cross-border travel, expand trade/investment (DPM-FM Sihasak).

picks.title: 9 เดือนปี 69 "โรงแรม-ที่พัก" เลิกกิจการพุ่ง 42%
picks.memo: Jan-Sep 2026: 148 hotels/lodgings deregistered (+42% YoY), 779 new registrations (down); KResearch warns sector fragile.

picks.title: Car production recovers from September flooding
picks.memo: Automakers accelerating output after eastern-region flooding subsided; factories back to normal, targets maintained.
